Template: switched ExecStart binary resolution from settings-only to per-service-first.

Single line change in src/gpumod/templates/systemd/vllm.service.j2:
  - before: {{ settings.vllm_bin | default('vllm') }}
  - after:  {{ unit_vars.vllm_bin | default(settings.vllm_bin | default('vllm'), true) }}

Resolution order: unit_vars.vllm_bin → settings.vllm_bin → 'vllm' (PATH). The 'true' flag on the outer default makes empty string also fall back, not just undefined.

Implemented per groomed plan (6 steps).

Step 1 - RAM safeguard refactor (RED/GREEN/REFACTOR):
  - Constants RAM_HEADROOM_RATIO/RAM_ABSOLUTE_HEADROOM_MB/RAM_HARD_FLOOR_MB moved from manager.py to services/ram.py
  - New pure function check_ram_safeguard(incoming_vram_mb, ram, hard_floor_mb=None) - one source of truth
  - manager.py delegates; existing tests preserved unchanged

Step 2 - CLI subcommand gpumod preflight ram:
  - New src/gpumod/cli_preflight.py with preflight_app typer
  - Exit codes: 0 safe, 1 unsafe (stderr diagnostic), 2 unknown service-id
  - --hard-floor MB override supported
  - Wired into cli.py via add_typer

Step 3 - Service.preflight_required: bool = False as first-class field
  - Added to both Service model and PresetConfig (YAML loader)
  - to_service() passes it through

Step 4 - gpumod_bin settings collection
  - Added to _binary_keys in both unit_installer.py and cli_template.py
  - Auto-detect via shutil.which('gpumod')

Step 5 - Template ExecStartPre conditional
  - vllm.service.j2, llamacpp.service.j2, fastapi.service.j2
  - Renders only when service.preflight_required is true
  - Uses {{ settings.gpumod_bin | default('gpumod') }}

Step 6 - Manual e2e: deferred to operator (no real GPU allocation in tests)

Quality gates green: ruff lint + ruff format + mypy strict + 2124 unit tests passing (was 2103; added 21 new).

Notes:
- Existing preflight/ram_check.py::RAMCheck preserved untouched. Different concern (inference-time runtime headroom, used by lifecycle.start preflight chain). The new safeguard is the freeze-prevention allocation-time check.
- RAMTracker(meminfo_path=...) default made lazy so monkey-patching the module-level _MEMINFO_PATH works for tests.
- Coexistence with gpumod-fva: same formula, same constants; gpumod-fva safeguard is Python-API only, this ticket adds the systemd-unit-level safeguard so direct systemctl starts / Restart=on-failure / autostart all get caught too.

Unblocks: gpumod-ng7 (driver venv compat — can now consume the same preflight CLI for venv validation).

Implemented per 5-step groomed plan.

Step 4 (foundation): Service.compat + PresetConfig.compat fields added as dict[str,str] | None = None. to_service() maps the new field. Tests in test_models.

Step 1 (library): src/gpumod/services/venv_compat.py exports:
  - CompatStatus enum (OK | DRIFT | MISSING)
  - CompatViolation + CompatResult dataclasses (frozen)
  - read_installed_versions(venv_root) — parses dist-info METADATA files directly (no subprocess, no imports — works when target venv is broken)
  - check_compat(declared, installed) — PEP 440 specifier validation via packaging.SpecifierSet
  - find_venv_root(service, settings) — resolves from unit_vars.vllm_bin → settings.vllm_bin → shutil.which fallback
Name normalisation per PEP 503 (lowercase + hyphens) so huggingface_hub and huggingface-hub match.

Step 2 (doctor CLI): src/gpumod/cli_doctor.py — gpumod doctor venv --service-id <id> [--profile <name>]
  - exit 0: OK or no compat declared (no-op success)
  - exit 1: DRIFT or MISSING with per-line diagnostic on stderr
  - exit 2: unknown service id

Step 3 (compat CLI): src/gpumod/cli_compat.py — gpumod compat list and compat show <name>
  - lists shipped profiles via importlib.resources
  - prints YAML content
  - exit 1 with available list when unknown

Step 5 (shipped profile): src/gpumod/compat/profiles/vllm-0.11.yaml with the known-good combination from the 2026-05-19 venv-isolation fix. Wired into wheel via tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel.force-include in pyproject.toml.

Dependencies added: packaging>=24.0,<26.0 (for PEP 440 specifiers). Already transitively available; explicit add is correct.

Tests: 23 new unit tests across test_venv_compat (12), test_cli_doctor (6), test_cli_compat (3), test_models (2). Suite: 2147 passed (was 2124).
